meta_title: Crypto payments for freelancers & creators · Dynopay
meta_description: Accept crypto payments for freelancers & creators with Dynopay. No chargebacks, global clients, 15+ cryptocurrencies. Start receiving payments in 10 minutes.
h1: Accept crypto payments for freelancers & creators without chargebacks or borders
subheading: Get paid in Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 12+ other cryptocurrencies. Funds arrive directly in your wallet—never locked by a platform.
intro_paragraph: When you sell digital services, templates, or coaching across borders, PayPal can hold your funds for up to 180 days and clients reverse charges months later. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto commerce platform built for freelancers and creators who want global payments without chargebacks. You receive funds directly in your own wallet, and fees start at 1.5% then drop to 0.5% at scale. No monthly fees, no frozen funds, no refund fraud.

features.title: Your wallet, your custody always
features.description: Dynopay never holds your funds. Every payment lands directly in the wallet you control, so no platform can freeze your earnings or delay withdrawals.

features.title: Zero chargeback risk on services
features.description: Crypto payments are final. Clients can't reverse a payment 90 days after you delivered a logo, website, or coaching call—eliminating refund abuse.

features.title: Tips, products, and payment links
features.description: Collect tips at dynopay.com/@yourhandle, sell digital products with hosted checkout, or share payment links for invoices. One platform handles all three.

how_it_works: Sign up with your email, verify it, and create your company profile in under three minutes.
Add your Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoin wallet address—just one payout destination to start receiving payments.
Generate a payment link, embed checkout on your site, or share your personal tip page and go live.

faqs.question: Do I need to hold cryptocurrency to accept crypto payments as a freelancer?
faqs.answer: No. You only need a wallet address where payments arrive. You can create a free wallet in minutes with Exodus, MetaMask, or Coinbase Wallet, then convert crypto to your local currency on an exchange whenever you choose.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies can freelancers and creators accept with Dynopay?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, MATIC, TRX, and stablecoins like USDT (ERC20, TRC20, Polygon) and USDC. You choose which assets to accept per product or link.

faqs.question: What fees does Dynopay charge for crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop automatically to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. Your first payment is completely free. No monthly fees, setup costs, or hidden charges.

faqs.question: Can clients dispute or reverse a crypto payment after I deliver work?
faqs.answer: No. Cryptocurrency transactions are final and irreversible. Once a client pays, they cannot file a chargeback or payment dispute—protecting you from refund fraud common with credit cards and PayPal.

faqs.question: How quickly can I start accepting crypto payments as a creator?
faqs.answer: You can go live in under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add your wallet address, and generate a payment link or personal tip page. No lengthy application, credit checks, or business documentation required.

cta_body: Your first payment is fee-free. Go live in 10 minutes with no monthly costs and funds sent directly to your wallet.
